title: [Browser Look L3] Admit real CSS for checked Web Component style surfaces
body:
Parent #5354. Depends on #5366 visual Look semantics, #5377 Look authoring, #5376 Web Component browser Back and #5367 certified accessibility. This issue owns **browser CSS admission and realization**, not Look syntax or semantic components.

## Outcome
Let a Look carry *real CSS* (a finite checked literal or exact versioned data reference) and style the actual selected browser Web Component via declared custom properties, slots and `::part()` surfaces. Compact and spacious are two Looks on the same component, with independent optional dark/light palette. Use the browser's existing CSS layout engine, including Grid/Flex and responsive reflow within validated structural constraints. Do not make ConduitOS parse CSS.

## Work
- Inventory current `targets/browser/host/assets/application-presentation.mjs`, `application-theme.mjs`, package resource limits, `semantics/presentation/src/application_theme.rs`, CSS token encoding and accepted Phosphor defaults. Migrate theme sources into canonical Look while preserving Face/action semantics and admitting a versioned Look stylesheet with exact content digest, byte/rule/resource bounds and selectable Host capability.
- Look CSS targets **only the style hooks exposed by the selected component Back**, e.g. its declared parts/custom properties. The checked component Fore/structure owns semantic subjects, required slots and accessibility traversal; Look controls density, spacing, geometry preferences, typography, paint, animation and decoration *only as compatible with that Fore*. A Look may trigger reflow/re-measure, not produce a new application action or content.
- Separate the executable browser CSS surface from source authority. For certified Looks specify enforceable restricted selectors/declarations, resource references, URL/import/font rules and finite geometry/animation constraints; prohibit arbitrary network/script side effects and unsupported overrides of trusted controls.
- **Do not claim a static CSS linter alone proves accessibility.** Validate at rendering time where needed: control remains reachable/visible under focus, keyboard order and pointer target, high zoom, long Unicode labels, forced colors, reduced motion, narrow viewports. Failed certification selects a recorded, safe generic Look or refuses if no honest fallback.
- Do not over-restrict genuine layout expression: CSS Grid/Flex, responsive media queries and animation may be valid where checked content/traversal remains semantically complete. Conversely, a stylesheet that needs to alter actual component slot topology, role, action binding, or semantic order is asking for a different checked component recipe, not a Look.
- Preserve Face identity/revision and action targets across Look swap; retain selected Look digest, CSS bytes, Host/Boot, current component implementation, actual DOM effect and acknowledged Show.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Real browser renders same Todo component/Fore with compact vs spacious Looks using different **actual CSS**; screenshots at desktop and narrow viewport demonstrate visual differentiation without application edits.
- [ ] A separate palette-only Look change works without changing density or component topology.
- [ ] CSS uses registered exposed component style hooks; unknown part/token, disallowed unbounded remote import, invalid syntax/selector, oversized resource, unsupported font and absent stylesheet fail/fallback with precise reason.
- [ ] CSS attempts to conceal an essential action, obscure focus, reorder meaningful reading, break pointer/keyboard input or introduce generated authoritative text cannot pass a certified rendering. Normal decorations can vary.
- [ ] Under two Looks, actual Todo add/complete action emits the same current Show/revision-bound typed interaction; old Show rejects a stale action, no double mutation/Body rebirth.
- [ ] Accessibility tests include keyboard-only, 200%+ zoom, long text, contrast/forced colors and reduced motion with explicit browser-runtime inspection; unknown user CSS cannot automatically claim certification.
- [ ] Migrated Phosphor/Product browser paths render through canonical Look; old theme wire refuses. Host/resource budgets and actual browser provenance remain verified.

## Stop line
No CSS in Face, unrestricted browser JS as semantic authority, CSS renderer in the kernel, universal widget ontology or claims of mathematically complete WCAG compliance.

---

## Thin delivery slices (2026-10-13)
- [ ] **L1** #5654: Admit bounded validated CSS against registered component style hooks
- [ ] **L2** #5655: Render compact and spacious Todo Looks in packaged Chromium
- [ ] **L3** #5656: Enforce accessible styling and refusal on adversarial CSS

Needs #5366 visual Look, #5377 authoring, #5376 Web Component, #5367 accessibility; browser-only CSS, no ConduitOS CSS interpreter.

Do not start overlapping Mask/Look implementations simultaneously, WIP #5520.
